description: Shop settings shared by the game, the baristas, and the k6 rush. Times are in shop seconds; the real cluster runs timeScale times faster.

lesson-1-1.description: A steady morning: 20 walk-ins over 20 minutes.

lesson-1-2.description: A busier morning: 24 walk-ins over 20 minutes.

lesson-2.description: The 8:05 rush: 50 walk-ins over ten minutes.

lesson-3-1.description: The app launches: 36 customers over 15 minutes, 40% ordering in the app.

lesson-3-2.description: A long, steady rush: 54 customers over 30 minutes, 35% ordering in the app.

lesson-4-1.description: A latte-heavy morning: 28 walk-ins over 15 minutes, 70% lattes.

lesson-4-2.description: A quiet half hour: 16 walk-ins over 30 minutes, 70% lattes.

lesson-4-3.description: The app rush: 52 customers over 30 minutes, 35% ordering in the app, 70% lattes.

lesson-5-1.description: Quiet, then a rush, then quiet: 6 customers over 10 minutes, 36 over the next 10, then 6 over 15.

lesson-5-3.description: Bursts: four waves of 10 customers in 4 minutes, with quiet 6-minute gaps.

lesson-6.description: Offices order boxes of coffee in the middle of the rush: 36 walk-ins over 15 minutes, 1 in 5 of them a box.

lesson-7.description: An app-heavy rush: 40 customers over 20 minutes, half of them ordering in the app.

lesson-8.description: Half the customers just want a croissant: 36 walk-ins over 15 minutes.

batch.description: Steaming milk for two lattes at once. In the real shop one latte takes 2 minutes and two batched take 2.5, so a batch takes 1.25x one drink.

labor.description: Lesson 5: baristas are paid by the minute ($18 an hour), and each call-in pays at least a 15-minute shift.

menuExtras.label: Box of coffee
menuExtras.description: Lesson 6: a box of coffee for an office ties a barista up for 8 minutes.

menuExtras.label: Croissant
menuExtras.description: Lesson 8: grab-and-go. Served from the pastry case when it is stocked; otherwise a barista fetches and warms one.

menuExtras.label: Restock the case
menuExtras.description: Lesson 8: an idle barista refills the pastry case.
